name: scoretrack
description: ScoreTrack — compteur de scores universel (PWA statique, sans dépendance à l'exécution)

scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && tar -cf - --exclude=./.git --exclude=./.github --exclude=./node_modules --exclude=./tests --exclude=./docs --exclude=./scripts --exclude=./coverage --exclude=./test-results --exclude=./playwright-report --exclude=./.lighthouseci --exclude=./dist --exclude=./package.json --exclude=./package-lock.json --exclude=./eslint.config.js --exclude=./playwright.config.js --exclude=./vitest.config.js --exclude=./lighthouserc.json --exclude=./.prettierrc --exclude=./.prettierignore --exclude=./.editorconfig --exclude=./.gitignore --exclude=./README.md --exclude=./CHANGELOG.md --exclude=./CONTRIBUTING.md --exclude=./SECURITY.md . | tar -xf - -C dist
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:sw && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
